name: The George Inn
accommodation: Five king-size en-suite rooms and one family room
dogs: Welcome in dog-friendly rooms and public areas (charge applies)
beachAccess: Short drive to Saunton, Croyde and Woolacombe
confirmedFeatures: En-suite showers, free WiFi, TVs, tea and coffee, 24-hour entrance, cots on request
overview: A village pub on Exeter Road in Braunton with six first-floor rooms named after local spots, including Saunton, Croyde and Crow Point. Rooms are en-suite with free WiFi, dogs are welcome in some rooms and the bar, and the beaches are a short drive.
surfTripFit: Easy reach of Saunton, Croyde and Woolacombe, with food and a bar on site after a session.
